page_title: LEI 3-1 WHU | Leicester v West Ham 03/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+10' Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) is caught offside!

90+10' What an opportunity! Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90+3' 3 - 1 Goal! Crysencio Summerville plays the ball into the area and Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) gets on the end of it to glance a header into the back of the net. He makes it 3:1.
90+3' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) will take the corner.
90+1' Facundo Buonanotte comes off the pitch to be replaced by Jordan Ayew (Leicester).
90' There will be a minimum of 9 min. of added time.
90' 3 - 0 Patson Daka (Leicester) produces a moment of pure magic and scores a spectacular goal by striking the ball into the top left corner of the net!

87' A through ball from Patson Daka (Leicester) fails to reach Wilfred Ndidi as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Wilfred Ndidi could have got into a promising position.
84' The goal by Leicester is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
83' Wait! Referee Joshua Smith has indicated he is going to review the Leicester goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
81' Goal! 3:0. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) taps home from almost on the goal line after a lucky rebound fell at his feet.

80' A sweet pass finds Patson Daka (Leicester) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Lukasz Fabianski is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
80' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
79' We are about to witness a substitution. Niclas Fullkrug (West Ham) is replacing Mohammed Kudus.
76' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' Here is a change. Kasey McAteer is going off and Ruud van Nistelrooy gives the last tactical orders to Stephy Mavididi (Leicester).
74' Bilal El Khannouss is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
73' The game is interrupted now, Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
72' Kasey McAteer (Leicester) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
72' Michail Antonio (West Ham) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
71' Emerson (West Ham) will deliver the corner kick.

71' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, West Ham are going to take it.
70' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to West Ham.
68' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
68' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

67' Wilfred Ndidi (Leicester) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. Leicester have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) takes the corner.
62' Substitution. Carlos Soler did his best and is replaced by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham).
62' Julen Lopetegui decides to make a substitution. Vladimir Coufal will be replaced by Emerson (West Ham).
62' A substitution has been made. Tomas Soucek goes off and Michail Antonio (West Ham) comes on.

61' 2 - 0 Goal! Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) neatly controls a decent pass from Kasey McAteer. He looks up and smashes an unstoppable drive into the bottom left corner from the edge of the box. 2:0.
60' The referee signals a substitution. Wout Faes (Leicester) is brought on as a substitute for Jannik Vestergaard.
60' Ruud van Nistelrooy has decided to make a change. Patson Daka (Leicester) replaces Jamie Vardy.
59' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Joshua Smith due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Tomas Soucek (West Ham) and his team.
58' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) swings in a cross from the corner, but Mads Hermansen reads it well and gathers the ball.

57' Carlos Soler (West Ham) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and West Ham will take a corner.
56' The resulting corner from Carlos Soler (West Ham) is cleared.
56' West Ham take a short corner kick.

55' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) hammers the ball towards the top left corner, but it's not so easy to put it beyond Mads Hermansen, who denies him with a terrific save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to West Ham.
54' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
53' Chance! Tomas Soucek (West Ham) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Mohammed Kudus, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
51' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) is furious with himself. He is quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot, but his header goes well wide of the right post!
49' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
48' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' Julen Lopetegui makes a half-time substitution. Crysencio Summerville comes on in place of Danny Ings (West Ham).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Joshua Smith has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Carlos Soler (West Ham) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
45+3' Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Jamie Vardy, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
45+2' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Danny Ings (West Ham) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.
42' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
41' West Ham hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jamie Vardy (Leicester) was quite harsh and Joshua Smith didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Carlos Soler (West Ham) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the right post.
36' West Ham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

36' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Mads Hermansen makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner. West Ham force their opponents to concede a corner.
35' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

32' He should have scored! Kasey McAteer (Leicester) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the bottom left corner is pretty weak and Lukasz Fabianski makes an easy save.
27' Mohammed Kudus sends a terrific cross into the box. Tomas Soucek (West Ham) gets on the end of it but his header from the centre of the box goes just wide of the right post.
27' West Ham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
26' Carlos Soler (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and West Ham will have a corner.
22' Boubakary Soumare (Leicester) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

21' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Mads Hermansen pulls off a brilliant save.
20' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' Edson Alvarez (West Ham) fires the ball from distance, but it's blocked by a defender.
16' Wonderful pass from Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) for Danny Ings, but they can't profit from it as Mads Hermansen comes off his line to collect.
14' Danny Ings (West Ham) latches on to a nice cross and directs a header at goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball only hits the right post.
12' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.

11' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Mads Hermansen pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The ball goes out of play. West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
10' A pass from Tomas Soucek (West Ham) is intercepted by Mads Hermansen and the move breaks down.
9' He should have done better. Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is afforded space to connect with a Vladimir Coufal cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well over the crossbar.
9' The corner from Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) is hurriedly cleared.

8' Lukasz Fabianski pulls off a great save to deny Jamie Vardy (Leicester), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. Good work from Leicester as they win a corner.
2' Mohammed Kudus (West Ham) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.

2' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Bilal El Khannouss, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jamie Vardy (Leicester), who beats Lukasz Fabianski with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
2' Attention! Referee Joshua Smith straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
2' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) has a goal ruled out for offside!
1' The match has just started.
West Ham will kick-off.
Joshua Smith will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
